title: OpenMAIC turns course material into a multi-agent interactive classroom
friendlyTitle: OpenMAIC builds interactive lessons with several AI teachers
summary: OpenMAIC is an open-source classroom system that uses multiple AI roles to turn source material into interactive lessons and course experiences. Its recent 1.0 release adds an agent-assisted course-building workflow.
friendlySummary: This open-source project turns learning material into a classroom experience with different AI roles.
whyItMatters: Educators and training teams can prototype AI-guided lessons, inspect the orchestration code and adapt the system to internal learning material. Review generated teaching content and privacy settings before using it with learners.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teachers and training teams can test new lesson formats and change the code for their own material.
